research.title: Claude Code on Your Own Metal: Self-Hosted Runners, and What Still Leaves Your Network
research.whyTrending: Public beta opened August 6, 2026 (6 days ago) for Team and Enterprise. One command, `claude self-hosted-runner`, moves cloud session execution onto your own machines - repo checkouts, build artifacts and secrets stay put. But prompts, model responses, tool results and transcripts still travel to Anthropic for inference, and it is unavailable under ZDR. That gap is exactly what security reviewers will ask about and what nobody is writing honestly about yet.
